sloka: शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः ।स राघवः तत्र कथा प्रलापम् ।शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य ।आत्म अधिकारा विविधाः च वाचः ।प्रहृष्ट रूपस्य पुरे जनस्य ॥२-१६-४३॥
transliteration: śuśrāva rājamārgasthaḥ priyā vāca udāhṛtāḥ ।sa rāghavaḥ tatra kathā pralāpam ।śuśrāva lokasya samāgatasya ।ātma adhikārā vividhāḥ ca vācaḥ ।prahṛṣṭa rūpasya pure janasya ॥2-16-43॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, while riding along the highway overheard the pleasing words uttered by women standing on the elevation of their buildings. Thus hearing his own praise Rama proceeded along the highway.
